BETA Close X Associated British Foods PLC announced on April 21, 2026, that it repurchased 220,000 of its ordinary shares for cancellation at an average price of GBp 1831.66. The highest price paid per share was GBp 1858.00, and the lowest was GBp 1776.00. These transactions were conducted on the exchange through Barclays Capital Securities Limited as part of the company's share repurchase program. Disclaimer* Associated British Foods PLC 21 April 2026 21 April 2026 Associated British Foods plc Transaction in own shares Associated British Foods plc (the " Company ") announces that on 21 April 2026 it purchased for cancellation from Barclays Capital Securities Limited (" Barclays ") the following number of its ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence each pursuant to the authority granted by its shareholders as part of its share repurchase programme, details of which were announced on 25 February 2026. Description of shares: Associated British Foods plc Ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence Date of transaction: 21 April 2026 Number of shares repurchased: 220,000 Average price paid per share: GBp 1831.6555 Highest price paid per share: GBp 1858.0000 Lowest price paid per share: GBp 1776.0000 The Company intends to cancel these Shares. All shares were purchased from Barclays as an on exchange transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. The table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Barclays as part of the buyback programme.
